# test_npc_patrol_override — Scenario Graph Reference

PATROL OVERRIDE TEST (Phase 2-4)

This scenario tests the patrolOverride and speed/dwell actions (npc-behavior.js goToAndStay method).

TEST PROCEDURE:
1. Game starts — observe nurse patrolling between Station (5,3) → Bed1 (2,5) → Bed2 (8,5)
2. Normal patrol cycle takes ~15 seconds per leg
3. Interact with the EMERGENCY BUTTON in the room
4. This triggers 'emergency_activated' global = true
5. OBSERVE: Nurse immediately abandons patrol
6. Nurse walks directly to Emergency Station (5,8) at faster speed (150px/s vs 80px/s)
7. Nurse stands at Emergency Station with no dwell time
8. Monitor NPC says: 'Emergency response engaged'

EXPECTED BEHAVIOR:
- Nurse never completes current patrol leg (immediate interrupt)
- Direct path to emergency location (not following patrol waypoints)
- Visibly faster movement speed
- Stops at destination and remains stationary

TEST DURATION: 1-2 minutes

KEY VALIDATION:
✓ goToAndStay() successfully interrupts patrol
✓ Speed increase is visibly noticeable
✓ NPC reaches target and stops permanently
✓ patrolOverride action triggers correctly

## How to Read These Diagrams

| Shape | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Rounded rectangle | Teal | Room / physical area |
| Rectangle | Red | Lock, barrier, or interactive terminal |
| Diamond | Orange | Inventory item or credential |
| Diamond | Red/Pink | NPC or physical key |
| Diamond | Purple | VM flag (challenge completion token) |
| Rectangle | Blue | VM challenge |
| Ribbon | Amber | NPC conversation / action gate |
| Hexagon | Green | Story aim (objective) |
| Hexagon | Amber | Critical path node |
| Circle | Grey | AND gate (all inputs required) |
| Subroutine rect `[[…]]` | Green | Container (holds items) |
| Rounded rectangle | Amber | NPC in room (Rooms & Contents only) |

Edges: `-->` solid = hard dependency; `-.->` dashed = soft / narrative dependency or optional path.

The `▶` node marks the player's starting room.
